name: Aaron Howearth
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Howearth Psychology focuses on queer- and neurodiversity-affirming therapy... Aaron, a non-binary, gay man and AuDHDer (Autistic and ADHD), is a clinical psychologist who draws from various treatment modalities, including EMDR, cognitive-behavioural therapy, acceptance and committment therapy, schema therapy, somatic therapy, and mindfulness-based therapy.
specialties: queer-affirming therapy, neurodiversity-affirming, ADHD/autism assessment, eating disorders, EMDR, schema therapy, somatic therapy

name: Dani
title: Psychologist
description: Dani, non-binary, queer person and AuDHDer, is a psychologist who offers online support to people across Australia, drawing on therapeutic perspectives including CBT and Gestalt therapy. Practice focuses on queer- and neurodiversity-affirming therapy.

name: Arthur De Jesus
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Akbay Psychology is a private clinical psychology practice for LGBTQIA+ community members, particularly those from CALD and indigenous backgrounds. Provides treatment for trauma and stress (acute, complex, PTSD) and LGBTQIA-related concerns, drawing on Schema Therapy, CBT, ACT, EFT and trauma-informed models (polyvagal theory).
specialties: LGBTQIA+, CALD, trauma, complex trauma, PTSD, schema therapy, men's mental health, ADHD
identity: gay cisgender man of Filipino ethnicity

name: Alicia Shevlin
title: Psychologist
description: Works with adults experiencing single-incident or complex trauma, identity-related issues, and concerns related to sexual behaviour or sexuality, within a psychodynamic framework. She works with people of all genders, sexual orientations, and sex characteristics, including intersex people, and is experienced in providing therapeutic support to those in the transgender community.
specialties: psychodynamic therapy, complex trauma, sexuality, transgender, intersex, eating disorders, chronic illness

name: Ashley Depasquale
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Clinical Psychologist with an interest and passion in supporting adults with issues relating to their sexual health, including navigating non monogamous relationships and exploration of gender and sexual identity. I am sex positive, LGBTQI+ inclusive, kink friendly and welcoming of all relationship structures.
specialties: sex therapy, sexual health, vaginismus, non-monogamy, gender and sexual identity, kink friendly, LGBTQI+

name: Brydan Xavier
title: Psychologist
description: He is committed to providing gender-affirming care and is both kink and BDSM-friendly. Draws on CBT, DBT, ACT, Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR) and psychodynamic techniques; his approach is both intersectional and trauma-informed, with expertise in trauma including complex trauma and PTSD, sexual health and intimacy issues, and sexuality and gender identity concerns. As a member of the LGBTIQAPSB+ community...
specialties: gender-affirming care, kink/BDSM-friendly, EMDR, complex trauma, PTSD, sexual health, sexuality and gender identity, ADHD/ASD

name: Charlie Dean
title: Psychologist
description: Charlie (they/them) is a gender-fluid, bisexual, polyamorous, general psychologist residing in Melbourne. Charlie offers telehealth psychology appointments for adults and incorporates feminist, queer, and decolonial theories into their work.
specialties: queer theory, LGBTQIA+, polyamory, CBT, ACT, mindfulness

name: Nico Lugano
title: Psychologist (Clinical Psychology Registrar)
description: Person-centred, trauma-informed, and systems-aware therapy drawing on models such as Schema Therapy, Eye Movement Desensitisation & Reprocessing (EMDR), and ACT. Particular experience working with LGBTQIA+ clients (including trans and non-binary people), neurodivergent clients, and people navigating trauma (including abuse and sexual assault, dissociation, PTSD, CPTSD). Member of AusPATH.
specialties: schema therapy, EMDR, trauma, dissociation, PTSD, CPTSD, trans and non-binary, LGBTQIA+, neurodivergent
